final_goals: PRESERVE GERMANY PARTNERSHIP ABSOLUTELY: Eastern DMZ (PRU/SIL/WAR/BER) remains inviolable through S1913M minimum. This partnership is Russia's only strategic survival mechanism preventing Turkish annexation. A PRU/A WAR hold unconditionally regardless of southern collapse magnitude.

CONSOLIDATE AT WAR SINGLE-CENTER BASELINE: Accept MOS loss as operationally inevitable consequence of Germany partnership prioritization. Russia will stabilize at 1-supply-center (WAR) defensive position pending strategic flux emergence.

MONITOR GERMANY WESTWARD OFFENSIVE EFFECTIVENESS: If German forces successfully prosecute western campaign against France/England and create strategic flux (Paris/Brest capture enabling Franco-German sector collapse), evaluate whether redeployment corridors emerge enabling Russian southern repositioning toward competitive recovery trajectory (7+ supply centers). Partnership viability depends on Germany demonstrating concrete reciprocal support beyond 1-center survival threshold.

RECOGNIZE ITALY PARTNERSHIP UNRELIABILITY: Italy's Turkey coordination and convoy support commitment (ION-GRE-APU) neutralizes potential southern Turkish containment. Italy relegated to neutral Mediterranean power maintaining independent strategic focus divorced from Russian security interests.

REJECT AUSTRIA PARTNERSHIP DEPENDENCY: Austria's track record of failed commitments renders active alliance unreliable. Accept Austria as passive territorial buffer only—SER/RUM will hold or collapse based on Austrian capability, not Russian strategy. Zero dependence on Austrian assistance enables independent decision-making.

RESIST TURKEY COERCION ABSOLUTELY: Turkey's surrender ultimatum rejected entirely. Russia maintains defensive coherence and refuses strategic initiative capitulation through military intimidation. Any further Turkish aggression will be resisted with available defensive capacity.

HONEST OPERATIONAL EXECUTION: F1910M orders match stated defensive strategy (A PRU H, A WAR H)—ending multi-phase rhetoric/execution oscillation. Execute announced moves precisely or abandon announcements entirely. Operational credibility restoration through transparent capability limitation acknowledgment superior to ambitious rhetoric masking impossibility.
